items.name: Dobřejovice Special 2027
items.information:
# ENGLISH

**Mandatory Competition tutorial**

All competitors are required to complete the official competitor tutorial before being allowed to participate in the competition. This requirement applies to everyone, not only newcomers.
Competitors who do not attend the tutorial will not be permitted to compete.

**Special Competition Format**

This competition will be held using a special format in which all events run simultaneously.
Each competitor will have a 35-minute cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.
Each competitor in blindfolded events will have a 3-hour cumulative limit to complete attempts in any events they choose.


# ČESKY

**Povinný tutoriál pro soutěžící**

Všichni závodníci musí před začátkem soutěže absolvovat oficiální tutoriál. Tato povinnost platí pro všechny, nejen pro nováčky.
Závodníkům, kteří se tutoriálu nezúčastní, nebude umožněno soutěžit.

**Speciální formát soutěže**

Tato soutěž bude probíhat ve speciálním formátu, ve kterém všechny disciplíny běží zároveň.
Každý soutěžící má k dispozici 35 minut, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.
Každý soutěžící v disciplínách poslepu má k dispozici 3 hodiny, během kterých může skládat libovolné disciplíny podle vlastního výběru.

Attendance is not required for the entire competition. However, please arrive at least **15 minutes** before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own puzzles for the events you are competing in.

## First-Time Competitors:
All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) for a basic overview of the rules.

## Implementation of 4-Pad
The World Cube Association has announced that as of January 2nd, 2027, all timed attempts must use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode, as opposed to the previous 2-pad mode. This competition will be the first in Alberta to do so. You can read the WCA's announcement [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/adoption-of-4-pad-timing-august-2026).

## Notice of Filming and Photography:
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Bolivia Nationals 2026
items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩

Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing.

Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial.

La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!**   🟥🟨🟩
His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special.

We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship.

Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia!

**(Português) Brasileiro**
É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara!

Decidimos continuar o formato do ano passado, com um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL).

É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/).

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'.

**English**
We are really excited to announce a new Capivara!

We have decided to keep last year's format, with one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to.

Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA).

It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.name: Greek Championship 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIwMDI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d9727f3eff01bd8f944a91a78f4c2e90bdf593f/image.png)
####Η μέρα που όλη η ελληνική κοινότητα cubing περιμένει έρχεται ξανά!
**4ο Πανελλήνιο Πρωτάθλημα Cubing 2026!**

Στις **12 και 13 Δεκεμβρίου 2026**, όλοι οι cubers συναντιόμαστε στην **αίθουσα ΑΤΛΑΣ του ξενοδοχείου PRESIDENT** για ένα ξεχωριστό διήμερο γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και αξέχαστες στιγμές!

**Ο διαγωνισμός απευθύνεται σε όλους, έμπειρους και αρχάριους!** Είτε έχετε ήδη πολλές συμμετοχές είτε αυτή θα είναι η πρώτη σας αγωνιστική εμπειρία, σας περιμένουμε να γίνετε μέρος της διοργάνωσης, να γνωρίσετε άλλους cubers και να απολαύσετε τη χαρά της συμμετοχής.
Και φυσικά, η κορυφή έχει ξεχωριστή σημασία: **ο νικητής του διαγωνισμού θα αναδειχθεί Πρωταθλητής Ελλάδας για το 2026!**

**Όλοι όσοι συμμετάσχουν τόσο στο PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026 όσο και στο Πρωτάθλημα Ελλάδας 2026 δικαιούνται έκπτωση 5€**, ανεξάρτητα από το αν είναι μέλη της λίγκας. Η έκπτωση θα αποδοθεί ως επιστροφή στην κάρτα με την οποία πραγματοποιήθηκε η πληρωμή, μετά το κλείσιμο των εγγραφών και την οριστικοποίηση της συμμετοχής τους.

Το **Πρωτάθλημα Ελλάδας 2026** αποτελεί τη μεγάλη συνάντηση της ελληνικής κοινότητας cubing και ταυτόχρονα την **4η αγωνιστική της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Είναι η ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσετε τις δυνάμεις σας, να κυνηγήσετε νέα προσωπικά ρεκόρ και να μοιραστείτε την αγωνία και τη χαρά του διαγωνισμού με ανθρώπους που αγαπούν το cubing όσο κι εσείς.

Τα μέλη της **[GREEK CUBING LEAGUE](https://greekcubingleague.gr)** δικαιούνται **επιστροφή 5€** για τη συμμετοχή τους στο Πρωτάθλημα, η οποία θα πραγματοποιηθεί επίσης μετά το κλείσιμο των εγγραφών και την οριστικοποίηση της συμμετοχής τους. Οι δύο παροχές ισχύουν **αθροιστικά**, επομένως τα μέλη της λίγκας που θα συμμετάσχουν και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς θα λάβουν **συνολική επιστροφή 10€** στην κάρτα τους.

Είτε διεκδικείτε μια θέση στο βάθρο είτε συμμετέχετε για την εμπειρία, σας περιμένουμε να ζήσουμε μαζί ένα συναρπαστικό αγωνιστικό διήμερο στο **4ο Πανελλήνιο Πρωτάθλημα Cubing!**

Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)
The moment the entire Greek cubing community has been waiting for is coming again!  
**The 4th Greek Championship 2026**

On **12–13 December 2026**, cubers will come together in the **ATLAS Hall at the PRESIDENT Hotel** for two exciting days of speed, competition and unforgettable moments!

**The competition welcomes everyone, from experienced competitors to complete beginners!** Whether you have competed many times before or this will be your first competition, join us to meet fellow cubers and enjoy the experience.

And, of course, the top spot carries a special honour: **the winner of the competition will be crowned Greek National Champion for 2026!**

**Everyone competing in both PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026 and Greek Championship 2026 is eligible for a €5 discount**, regardless of league membership. The discount will be issued as a refund to the card used for payment, after registration closes and participation is confirmed.

The **Greek Championship 2026** is the major gathering of the Greek cubing community and also serves as the **4th round of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! It is your chance to challenge yourself, chase new personal bests and share the excitement of competing with people who love cubing just as much as you do.

Members of the **[GREEK CUBING LEAGUE](https://greekcubingleague.gr)** are eligible for a **€5 refund** for their participation in the Championship, also issued after registration closes and participation is confirmed. The two benefits **can be combined**, so league members competing in both events will receive a **total refund of €10** to their card.

Whether you are aiming for the podium or taking part for the experience, we look forward to welcoming you to an exciting weekend at the **4th Greek National Cubing Championship!**

Important Note:  For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register through the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the next tabs.

items.information:
# REGISTRO 🇧🇷
**A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:**

* Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
* Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
* Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$20,00 pagos antecipadamente via PIX. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **PIX: renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscrições so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**
* Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (umberto.santos@sesisp.org.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: Alunos do SESI SANTOS estão isentos da taxa de insrição, mas devem Informar que são alunos do SESI no campo INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS durante o ato da inscrição.

# REGISTRATION 🇬🇧
**The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:**

* Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
* Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
* Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$20,00 paid in advance via PIX. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **PIX: renan.cunha20@gmail.com**
* Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**
* For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (umberto.santos@sesisp.org.br), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org).

OBS.: SESI SANTOS students are exempt from the registration fee, but they must inform that they are SESI students in the ADDITIONAL INFORMATION field during registration.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

The university demands this registration for safety standards.

items.name: Örebro Open 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till den andra upplagan av Örebro Open! 

Detta blir Sveriges andra tävling med Dual Rounds, vilket innebär att alla tävlande i 3x3, OH och 2x2 har möjligheten att få tävla i minst två rundor.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to the 2nd edition of Örebro Open!

This will be Sweden's second competition with Dual Rounds, which means that all competitors in 3x3, OH and 2x2 are allowed to compete in at least two rounds.

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

items.name: Coralito Bahía de Banderas 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1NzMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--15740010cf766262637c38629cab00fad9ef50e2/1000228331.png)

###### Español 
Coralito Bahia de Banderas esta de vuelta!

Coralito Bahía de Banderas regresa para celebrar su **segunda edición**, retomando el lugar donde comenzó todo. Hace dos años, este evento marcó un momento especial al convertirse en la **primera competencia de la WCA realizada en Bahía de Banderas**, reuniendo por primera vez a speedcubers y aficionados en una misma sede.

Esta segunda edición busca volver a reunir a la comunidad del cubing para compartir la emoción de competir, mejorar tiempos, conocer nuevos competidores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de la pasión por los cubos Rubik.

Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad **Vallarta Speed**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

##### AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

###### English
Coralito Bahía de Banderas is back!

Coralito Bahía de Banderas returns for its **second edition**, going back to the place where it all began. Two years ago, this event marked a special moment by becoming the **first WCA competition ever held in Bahía de Banderas**, bringing speedcubers and enthusiasts together at the same venue for the first time.

This second edition aims to bring the cubing community together once again to share the excitement of competing, improving times, meeting new competitors, and, above all, enjoying the passion for Rubik’s Cubes.

This competition is organized by the **Vallarta Speed community**.


This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

##### NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

* Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia.

​

​

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MTU3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6767acf00e820f8d8610aadf63d58431dcd8b4b9/cubestore%20pre-championship.jpg)

**PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026**

Στις 14 και 15 Νοεμβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά στο **Panellinios Club House** για έναν ξεχωριστό διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές.

Το **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα την 3η αγωνιστική της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Τα μέλη της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 4€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους μετά την ημερομηνία που αυτές θα κλείσουν.

Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός, που θα διαρκέσει και τις δυο μέρες του Σαββατοκύριακου, αποτελεί το ιδανικό αγωνιστικό warm-up πριν από το μεγάλο γεγονός της χρονιάς, το **Εθνικό μας Πρωτάθλημα**. 
Είναι η ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσετε τις δυνάμεις σας, να βελτιώσετε τις επιδόσεις σας και να προετοιμαστείτε κατάλληλα για τη μεγάλη διοργάνωση που ακολουθεί.

Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! 
Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε να ζήσουμε μαζί μια ακόμη μεγάλη γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες.

**Σημείωση:** Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή, πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **ΚΑΙ** να γίνει η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα.
Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

**PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026**

On November 14 and 15, 2026, all Cubers will meet again at **Panellinios Club House** for a special two-day competition filled with speed, competition and unforgettable moments.

The **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** will also be the third competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!

Members of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) will receive a **€4 refund** on their card as soon as their registration is finalized, upon completion of the registration process.

Taking place over both days of the weekend, this competition will be the ideal competitive warm-up before the biggest event of the year: **our National Championship**. It is the perfect opportunity to test your skills, improve your performances and prepare properly for the major competition that follows.

Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Bring your cubes, read the regulations and join us for another great celebration of cubing!

Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs.
Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

# Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum.

Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut.

**Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.**

**Catatan Penting:**
Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama)

Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
* **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori
* **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
* **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3

Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung.

Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag.

Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event.

Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran.

-----------------------

# Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026!

Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public.

All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition.

All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified.

**On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.**

**Important Notes:**
There are competitor limits for the following events:
* 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors)
* 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors)
* 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors)

There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition:
* **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event
* **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality
* **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event

By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event.

All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag.

Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event.

Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7.
If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/INVENTUMPatoBranco2026/register).

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/INVENTUMPatoBranco2026/register) tab.

There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.

---


**UACh al Cubo 2026 esta aquí**

La primera competencia de Speedcubing llega a la ciudad de Valdivia. No te pierdas esta jornada llena de rompecabezas. 

Esta competencia está organizada en colaboración con la [Facultad de Ciencias de la Ingeniería de la Universidad Austral de Chile](https://www.instagram.com/fciuach/).

Por favor leer **ATENTAMENTE** las pestañas[ Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80093-preguntas-frecuentes), [Rondas Duales / Dobles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80098-rondas-duales-dobles) y [Competidores Nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80094-competidores-nuevos).

---

**UACh al Cubo 2026 is here**

The first speedcubing competition is coming to the city of Valdivia. Don't miss this event packed with puzzles. 

This competition is organized in collaboration with the [Faculty of Engineering Sciences at the Universidad Austral de Chile](https://www.instagram.com/fciuach/).

Please read the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80093-preguntas-frecuentes), [Dual/Double Rounds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80098-rondas-duales-dobles), and [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UAChalCuboValdivia2026#80094-competidores-nuevos) tabs **CAREFULLY**.

items.information:
## Welcome to the Penang Cube Open 2026!

[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/PenangCubeOpen2026)

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the Updates & Announcements and the New Competitors tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

Competitors should ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.

*Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.*

There will be special age categories and first timer categories for the 3x3x3 event first round:
**Female Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round for female competitors
**Under 12 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 12 and under
**Under 17 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 13 - 17
**Above 18 Category** - Top 3 winners from 3x3x3 event first round age 18 and above
**First Timer** - All first timer competitors will received certificate of participation

items.information:
Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2026! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)".

-----

Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2026!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)".

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4NjQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ab88a0502a3ba472356141b81e552f91ce257a19/image.png)

### Deutsch

Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026!

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. November wollen wir an den Erfolg des Vorjahres anknüpfen und Euch alle wieder herzlichst nach Cottbus einladen. Dieses Jahr möchten wir uns sogar noch steigern und gehen mit mehr Teilnehmenden und mehr Comp-Tagen an den Start. Dieses Jahr wird Cottbus Cubing von GANCube unterstützt

Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln!

**Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.**

### English

Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition!

We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days. This year, Cottbus Cubing is being supported by GANCube

We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes!

**Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.**

Vielen Dank!
Habt alle ein entspanntes Wochenende

items.information:

Everyone can participate, but only people with Namibia nationality can win prizes and honours.

The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyNDgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e88ce5718f2045f0e748da68cc0c5f3f442c3f38/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-02%20at%2015.56.14.jpeg)

Bem-vindos ao CAU ao Cubo 2026, em Itajaí!

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8). 

Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.

Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino, novatos, seniores e alunos do CAU na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'.

A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida apenas pela primeira rodada). A premiação extra-oficial dos alunos do CAU será feita de acordo com uma pontuação geral entre todas as modalidades, e será dividida entre Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio.

Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para os eventos do segundo dia (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx e 3x3x3 OH). Por gentileza, esteja no local com no mínimo 1 hora de antecedência.

🇺🇸 Welcome to the CAU ao Cubo 2026, competition in Itajaí!

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any difficulties with registration, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/4yo7IqbcgOA?si=SJNiCFCSh-eLN550).

Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

We will have awards for all official events, as well as unofficial awards for women, beginners, seniors, and CAU students in the '3x3x3 Cube' event.

The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (they will not be based solely on the first round results). The unofficial awards for CAU students will be based on an overall score across all events and will be divided into Elementary School I, Elementary School II, and High School.

On-site registration will be accepted only for the events on the second day (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx, and 3x3x3 One-Handed). Please arrive at the venue at least 1 hour in advance.

## VOLUNTEERING
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png)

You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg)

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg)

##Accommodation 

The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions.



## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS
Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time.

## About CubingZA
CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.
If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information:
# 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다.
# 멀티 블라인드: 전체 참가자 중 선착순 50%만 가능
# [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다.

WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento **será necessário informar o CPF e nome** tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas

**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it **will be required to inform an ID number** for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted

**ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc0MTMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a458e6deff7a3097077605b82ba6ed6cb6f8495/60d4732d-5344-4eab-a473-19f2d1891969.png)

**German**
Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber,

wir freuen uns, euch zum 2. Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende 2026 am 24. und 25. Oktober 2026 einzuladen.

Nach zwei erfolgreichen Ausgaben im Herbst 2025 und Frühjahr 2026 heißen wir euch erneut in Wuppertal zu einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerbswochenende willkommen. 
Teilnehmende aller Erfahrungsstufen sind herzlich eingeladen – ganz gleich, ob es eure erste Competition ist oder ihr bereits an vielen Wettbewerben teilgenommen habt.
Wir freuen uns auf ein Wochenende mit offiziellen Solves, neuen persönlichen Bestzeiten und dem Austausch mit der Community.

Bitte lest vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch.
Wir hoffen, euch in Wuppertal zu sehen!

**English**
Dear cubers,

We are excited to invite you to the 2nd Wuppertal Cubing Weekend 2026 on October 24–25, 2026.

Following two successful editions in autumn 2025 and spring 2026, we are once again delighted to welcome you to Wuppertal for an official WCA competition weekend.
Participants of all experience levels are warmly invited to join—whether this is your very first competition or you have already attended many events.
We look forward to a weekend of official solves, new personal bests, and connecting with the cubing community.

Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.
We hope to see you in Wuppertal!

items.name: Salonica Autumn Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b39acc8afc2f42f3a6da807026b51e138f0abec/image.png)

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει!

Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές.

Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. 

Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing!

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι:

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI)

**SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026**
Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back!

On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments.

Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**!
Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process.

Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration!

Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information.

Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026
items.information:
**Welcome to Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026!**

**SPECTATORS**
Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support!
​
**VOLUNTEERING**
Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).
​
**IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS**
Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

## [EN]

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Tuesday October 6th, 2026 at 8 pm (12 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Ottawa Side Events Series

This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Side Events B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0).

If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?si=zHT9ze8Wlfopxkr2).

**¡Celebremos juntos los 10 años del SpeedCube Baja Open!**

El torneo más icónico de Baja California regresa en 2026 para conmemorar una década desde aquella primera competencia en 2016. Durante estos 10 años, SpeedCube Baja Open ha sido escenario de récords, emoción y la unión de la comunidad cubera.  
Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/).

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**  
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing y Baja Cubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.  
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.  
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**Let’s celebrate 10 years of SpeedCube Baja Open!**

The most iconic tournament in Baja California returns in 2026 to commemorate a decade since the very first competition in 2016. Over these 10 years, SpeedCube Baja Open has been the stage for records, excitement, and the unity of the cubing community.   
This is a WCA sanctioned competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**  
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by the Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing and Baja Cubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.  
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.  
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CuberBrasilSumare2026/register).

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a CubingSP, Cuber Brasil, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
By registering, you authorize CubingSP, Cuber Brasil, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

[*FR*] Étant donné qu'il s'agit du Championnat officiel de Speedcubing de Suisse, les 12 meilleurs compétiteurs suisses du tour précédent ainsi que tous les participants d'autres nationalités se classant entre eux se qualifient pour les finales respectives.

[*EN*] As these are the official Swiss Speedcubing Championship, the best 12 Swiss competitors of the previous round as well as all participants of other nationalities in between qualify for the respective finals.

items.information:
##### 🇧🇷
Seja bem vindo ao **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Instruções de participação:

* Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register).
* As inscrições vão até o dia **02/10/2026**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes.
* Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará.
* Todos os participantes devem ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição.
* O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição.
* Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal.
* Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento.
* Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para para o e-mail da organização (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores!
* Divirta-se!

---

##### 🇺🇸
Welcome to **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Participation instructions:

* All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register) tab.
* Registration closes on **10/02/2026**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies.
* Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating.
* All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
* The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition.
* There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian.
* All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in.
* If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the organization (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers!
* Have fun!

items.information:
### 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Bergen Open. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

##### Nye Deltakere
Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors).

##### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette er også helt gratis. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

---

### 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to to Bergen Open! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete.

#### New Competitors
There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab.

##### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for free aswell. We still strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/bergenopen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. ---

Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

Запрошуємо всіх охочих взяти участь у змаганнях зі швидкісного складання кубика Рубіка — події, яка об'єднає любителів спідкубінгу заради доброї справи.

 Уся актуальна інформація щодо реєстрації, розкладу, правил, можливих змін та інших організаційних питань публікуватиметься в Telegram-групі заходу.

Speed ​​​​Rubik's Cube Competition in Support of Ukraine 🇺🇦
We invite everyone who wants to take part in the speed Rubik's Cube competition - an event that will unite speedcubing enthusiasts for a good cause.
This is not only an opportunity to test your skills, compete with the strongest participants and spend time in a friendly atmosphere, but also to support Ukraine. Together we prove that every move matters, and unity makes us stronger.
All relevant information regarding registration, schedule, rules, possible changes and other organizational issues will be published in the Telegram group of the event.
Solve it quickly. Support Ukraine. Together to victory! 💙💛

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).


---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Budući da se FMC i discipline slaganja naslijepo ne nalaze na [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), ovo je Vaša prilika da postanete Hrvatski prvak u tim disciplinama.

Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 is a competition that will take place in Zagreb. Anyone may participate, regardless of nationality or age. We recommend that all competitors become familiar with the WCA Regulations.

Since FMC and blindfolded events will not be held at [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the Croatian champion in those events.

Awards for the top 3 Croatian competitors will be presented at the ceremony in Petrinja one week later.

*You do not have to compete at Croatian Championship to take part in this competition.*

For more information, please check the other tabs on the competition page.

items.information:

Welcome to Maltese Championship 2026, the fourth official WCA competition in Malta!

Whether you’re competing for the first time or returning for another competition, we’re excited to welcome you to our growing speedcubing community.

Competitors from all countries are warmly invited to take part. While prizes and national titles are reserved for Maltese competitors, every participant will compete on equal terms and receive official WCA results.

Our aim is to make Maltese Championship 2026 our biggest and most welcoming competition yet, bringing together cubers of all ages and experience levels for a memorable day of competition and community. 

Be sure to check all tabs, especially [if you are a new competitor](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#76640-for-new-competitors).

**Registration is only possible online through this website. Check the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026/register) section for details.**

[T-shirts are available to order](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalteseChampionship2026#78743-championship-t-shirt-competitors-supporters) for competitors and supporters by the 6th September 2026.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d276ee4a1432869c38d809b8802b47006f609e10/Megamente_2026.png)

# Español

Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden.

**Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia.

Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?**

Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es...
**qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.**

#### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**.
​
**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/


# English
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot.

**Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition.

But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?**

Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is...
**how far you can push your mind.**

#### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**.

 Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1Njc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40a4223db9dd06f7297c00e40277715abf8db574/image.png)

Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών.

Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν.

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **B μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. 

Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 2X2
* 5X5
* One-Handed (OH)

The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way.

This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season.

Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année.
Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup.

Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes :
3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.**
Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup.

**Note aux débutants :**
Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable.

__________________________

Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. 
Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen.
**Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden:
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups.

**Hinweis für Neulinge:**
Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. 

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. 
Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.

**Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 
3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

**Note for newcomers:**
This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz.

**ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento será necessário informar o CPF e nome tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas

**ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge.

**ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it will be required to inform an ID number for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted

**ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 175kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med.

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 175 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών.

Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν.

**Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Α μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. 

Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού:
* 3x3
* 4x4
* pyraminx
* skewb
* clock

Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. 

Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. 

[Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg)

[Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI)

The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way.

This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season.

Important: This competition **is Part A** of a two-competition series. Competitors may participate in ONLY one of the two competitions in this series.

**Events (Part A):**
* 3x3
* 4x4
* pyraminx
* skewb
* clock

**ESPAÑOL**
🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶

## Caminos de Guanajuato – Guanajuato, Guanajuato 2026 
La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** finaliza su recorrido y en **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Esta competencia forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo.

En cada parada, la música de *José Alfredo Jiménez* acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Guanajuato.

El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música.

Te esperamos en Guanajuato para culminar juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**.

Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia.

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**
En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades.
Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.
📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**ENGLISH**
🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶

The **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** route ends its journey in **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, a city that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and everyday life come together in every corner. This competition is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing, but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different host cities through a shared spirit of competition and celebration.

At each stop along the way, the music of *José Alfredo Jiménez* symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have become an essential expression of the spirit and emotions of the people of Guanajuato, inspire this edition dedicated to Guanajuato.

The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music.

We look forward to seeing you in Guanajuato to finalize the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together.

This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition.

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**
Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities.
By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice.
📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**Important Information for Participants:**

**Location:** The competition will take place at the Atrium of the Mall

**Arrival Time:** Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be permitted to participate.

**Volunteering:** All participants are kindly requested to volunteer during the competition.

**ID Requirement:** First-time participants are required to bring an original, printed, or digital copy of their official ID card. Please ensure you have this with you.

**Cube Requirement:** Participants must bring their own cubes. Participants are responsible for the safety of their puzzles. If you have difficulty bringing puzzles, please contact us in advance so that we can make arrangements for you.

**International Participants:** If you are a citizen from outside India, please submit a copy of your Government-issued ID.
